event: BPER BANCA Crotone International Carnival Race 2026
procedural_matters: ITA 178 was represented by SQUILLACIOTI GABRIELE FRANCESCO.
International Jury was represented by Uros Zvan IJ (SLO).
facts: Race 3 for RED fleet,10 seconds before the starting signal.
Wind was 12-13kts, sea state was choppy.
ITA 178 was on starboard tack near the pin end vessel, full stop, luffed head to wind and made contact between her first port quarter and the starboard side of the pin end starting vessel.
ITA 178 became stuck with the pin end starting vessel for several seconds.
After getting clear, ITA 178 continued sailing the first beat to windward.
ITA 178 did not take any penalty and finished the race.
During the hearing ITA 178 admitted to knowingly touching the pin end starting vessel.
conclusions: ITA 178 touched the pin end starting vessel and broke RRS 31.

By knowingly breaking rule RRS 31 and not taking the appropriate penalty, ITA 178 failed to compete in compliance with the principles of sportsmanship and fair play as stated in RRS Basic Principles. ITA 178 broke RRS 2.
